tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Signature purple (source `--purple`, assets/styles.css :root). Accent text, links, eyebrows and selected-control fills on `paper`, `lavender` and `white` (7.08:1 on `paper`, 5.89:1 on `lavender`). Never normal-size text on `ink` (2.36:1) — use `violet-on-dark` there.

tokens.name: purple-deep
tokens.usage: Deep purple (assets/styles.css :root), the core secondary purple. Fills and large display blocks; text on it: `paper` 12.63:1, `violet-on-dark` 7.26:1, `muted-dark` 8.99:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Near-black ink (assets/styles.css :root). Headings and body text on `paper` (16.75:1) and `lavender` (13.93:1); the dark section ground.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Off-white paper (assets/styles.css :root). Default light canvas; text on `ink` (16.75:1) and on `purple-deep` (12.63:1).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Lavender (assets/styles.css :root). Softer sections, selected and hover surfaces; `ink` text 13.93:1, `purple` text 5.89:1, `muted-light` text 5.07:1.

tokens.name: violet-gray
tokens.usage: Violet-gray (assets/styles.css :root), the supporting neutral. Fills, rules and chips. As text: only on `ink` (8.36:1); on `paper` it is 2.00:1, so never text there.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: White (assets/styles.css :root). Text on `purple` fills (7.71:1) and on `lab-magenta-on-light` fills (7.92:1); Collision Lab hero text on `ink` (18.22:1).

tokens.name: muted-light
tokens.usage: Muted body text on light grounds (ct-lab/index.html :root): 6.09:1 on `paper`, 6.63:1 on `white`, 5.07:1 on `lavender`.

tokens.name: muted-dark
tokens.usage: Muted body text on dark grounds (ct-lab/index.html :root): 11.92:1 on `ink`, 8.99:1 on `purple-deep`.

tokens.name: violet-on-dark
tokens.usage: Lighter violet for links, meta and actions on `ink` and on inverted core tiles (assets/styles.css .rabbit-card:hover): 9.63:1 on `ink` (the v1 notes print 9.14:1; recomputed here), 7.26:1 on `purple-deep`.

tokens.name: collision-violet
tokens.usage: Collision Lab hero accent (collision-lab/index.html .collision-hero h1 span). Contextual, not a replacement for `purple`. Large and small text on `ink` (5.75:1); `ink` text on it also 5.75:1.

tokens.name: collision-eyebrow
tokens.usage: Collision Lab hero eyebrow on `ink` (collision-lab/index.html .collision-hero .eyebrow): 9.14:1.

tokens.name: lab-magenta
tokens.usage: CT LAB magenta (ct-lab/index.html :root). Use on `ink` only: 5.85:1. `ink` text on a magenta fill is 5.85:1. Never on `paper`.

tokens.name: lab-magenta-on-light
tokens.usage: CT LAB darker magenta for light grounds (ct-lab/index.html :root): 7.28:1 on `paper`, 6.05:1 on `lavender`; `white` text on it 7.92:1.

tokens.name: lab-magenta-hover
tokens.usage: CT LAB hover tone on `ink` (ct-lab/index.html .track:hover): 9.16:1 on `ink`. Used when a light track tile inverts to `ink`.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error messages and the invalid-field border on paper and white (v1 manual .ds-contrast-error): 8.61:1 on `paper`, 9.37:1 on `white`. Always paired with the word "Error", never colour alone; close in hue to CT LAB's `lab-magenta-on-light`, so the word matters there. On ink surfaces errors use `paper` text.

tokens.name: lavender-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of an unselected ModeSwitch option on paper (v1 manual .ds-mode-button:hover). `ink` text 11.32:1, `purple` 4.79:1, `lab-magenta-on-light` 4.92:1.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a modal dialog: `ink` at 80% over any ground, so the dialog panel stands clear of the page. Not text; a v1 addition (no scrim in the source files).

tokens.name: accent-paper
tokens.usage: The expression's accent on a paper surface (`data-surface="paper"`): eyebrows, meta, text actions, nav underline, focus ring, selected fills. Core and Collision Lab `purple` 7.08:1 on `paper`; CT LAB `lab-magenta-on-light` 7.28:1. Text on its fill: `on-accent-paper`.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: The expression's accent on an ink surface (`data-surface="ink"`): core `violet-on-dark` 9.63:1 on `ink`, CT LAB `lab-magenta` 5.85:1, Collision Lab `collision-violet` 5.75:1. Text on its fill: `on-accent-ink`.

tokens.name: accent-ink-inverse
tokens.usage: The accent on a paper tile that has inverted to ink on hover or focus: CT LAB uses its hover magenta `lab-magenta-hover` (9.16:1 on `ink`, ct-lab/index.html .track:hover); core and Collision Lab keep their ink accent.

tokens.name: on-accent-paper
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill on a paper surface: `white` on `purple` 7.71:1, on `lab-magenta-on-light` 7.92:1.

tokens.name: on-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill on an ink surface: `ink` on `violet-on-dark` 9.63:1, on `lab-magenta` 5.85:1, on `collision-violet` 5.75:1.

tokens.name: line-paper
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and dividers on a paper surface (foundations.css `--vc-line`). Decorative separation only, about 1.4:1; a control boundary uses the text colour.

tokens.name: line-ink
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and dividers on an ink surface (foundations.css `--vc-line-dark`). Decorative separation only; a control boundary uses the text colour.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The page hero headline only, uppercase (v1 manual .ds-hero h1: clamp(4.8rem, 9.6vw, 10.9rem)); one per page.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Section-lead and hero headlines, set uppercase (v1 manual: clamp(3.7rem, 7.8vw, 8.6rem)). Scale down with the viewport; tracking runs -0.035em to -0.057em at the largest sizes.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Editorial tile titles, set uppercase (components.css .vc-tile h3: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 4.4rem)).

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Field file row titles, set uppercase (components.css .vc-file-row h3: clamp(1.5rem, 2.8vw, 2.7rem)).

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Group and palette headings inside a page (manual palette headings: clamp(1.1rem, 2.1vw, 1.7rem)).

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Large measured values in a Readout (v1 manual .ds-stats-number: clamp(2.5rem, 4.8vw, 5rem)). Units sit inside at 0.32em with no tracking.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrows above headlines, uppercase, tracked out. Source tracking is 0.22em (assets/styles.css .eyebrow); the v1 .vc-eyebrow normalization uses 0.18em.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Tile meta lines, uppercase; also the `Status` label.

styles.name: button-label
styles.usage: Button text, uppercase.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The text wordmark in navigation, uppercase. There is no logo file.

styles.name: index-number
styles.usage: Field file numbers, uppercase. Lifecycle status beside it uses the `Status` component.

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: Form field labels, uppercase (v1 manual .ds-contrast-inputs label).

styles.name: hero-lead
styles.sample: A shared visual language for research, experiments and the things I build to understand technology.
styles.usage: The paragraph under the hero headline, up to about 780px wide (v1 manual .ds-hero-lead: clamp(1.18rem, 1.8vw, 1.55rem)).

styles.name: body-lead
styles.sample: A shared visual language for research, experiments and the things I build to understand technology.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a section headline; keep to about 520px wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I investigate emerging technologies, turn questions into experiments, and build prototypes to find out what survives contact with reality.
styles.usage: Default running text. Line height 1.55 is a representative v1 value, not a single global rule in the source.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Navigation links and short descriptions.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and small muted notes: `muted-light` on paper, `muted-dark` on ink.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Technical detail: signal chains, code, hex values in running text. Mono marks raw data: what a person types or an instrument reports, never headings or prose.

styles.name: mono-input
styles.usage: Values typed into a Field (v1 manual .ds-contrast-inputs input).

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Codes, IDs and hex values beside a label, in the muted text colour (v1 manual .ds-swatch-info code).

tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page shell (`.vc-shell`).

tokens.name: layout-gutter
